_comment: Model manifest for the disaggregated-prefill runner (ADDING_A_PREFILL_MODEL.md sec 3).
Point a rank binding's global_env at it with PREFILL_MANIFEST=<this file>; prefill_runner
applies this env map with setdefault, so global_env (and, for a bare python runner, an
exported shell variable) still wins. Only the 'env' block is read (_apply_manifest_env).
PREFILL_SP is the mesh ROWS and PREFILL_TP the COLS (prefill_runner.py:69-71).
PREFILL_TP MUST stay 8: the packed cache holds one KV head per chip (R-027).
PREFILL_FABRIC_MODE=1d_ring is not optional with the Ring topology this package runs -- Ring
collectives need the cyclic torus route, and the engine would otherwise pick FABRIC_1D at
sp<=8 (runner_utils.py:37). It also needs TT_MESH_GRAPH_DESC_PATH pointed at
which tt-run/the shell must export -- a manifest cannot set it (DEC-020 / DEC-081).
CHUNK_SIZE and MAX_SEQ_LEN are deliberately NOT set here: they are per-run workload knobs that
must match the producer exactly, and a default hidden in the model manifest is how they drift.
